---
title: "IF-77 Electromagnetic Wave Propagation Model"
date: 2026-05-01
date-modified: 2026-05-06
---

The IF-77 Electromagnetic Wave propagation model predicts the basic transmission loss in the frequency range 125 MHz – 20 GHz for aeronautical and satellite services. It also calculates power available, power density, and/or a desired-to-undesired signal ratio.

{{< include /includes/_getting_started.qmd >}}

## Primary Functions

### IF77 Model

This function implements the primary method of the IF-77 electromagnetic wave propagation model. The inputs for this function are 3 Card structures shown below in @tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card1, @tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card2, @tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card3.

**if77 Card1 Inputs**

| Card1 structure          | Type   | Units | Limits                          | Description                                            |
|--------------------------|--------|-------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `output_type`            | enum   |       | See @tbl-if77-outputs           | Type of output desired                                 |
| `lobing_flag`            | enum   |       | See @tbl-if77-lobing            | Whether lobing should be used                          |
| `time_availability_flag` | enum   |       | See @tbl-if77-time_availability | Time availability option                               |
| `d__km`                  | double | km    | $d \geq 0$                      | Great-circle distance between terminals                |
| `percentage`             | double |       | $0 < percentage < 100$          | Variability time percentage                            |
: Card1 structure for the if77 propagation model {#tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card1}

The `output_type` input must be one of the following desired output types in **Output enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-outputs.

| Enum Value | Output Type enum |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| 1          | Calculate power available   |
| 2          | Calculate power density     |
| 3          | Calculate transmission loss |
: Allowed output type values {#tbl-if77-outputs}

The `lobing_flag` input must be one of the following desired lobing flags in **LobingFlag enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-lobing.

| Enum Value | Lobing Flag enum                  |
|------------|-----------------------------------|
| 0          | Do not use lobing in calculations |
| 2          | Use lobing in calculations        |
: Allowed lobing flag values {#tbl-if77-lobing}

The `time_availability_flag` input must be one of the following desired time availability flags in **TimeAvailability enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-time_availability.

| Enum Value | Time Availability enum   |
|------------|--------------------------|
| 1          | Hourly median levels     |
| 2          | Instantaneous levels     |
: Allowed time availability flag values {#tbl-if77-time_availability}

**if77 Card2 Inputs**

| Card2 structure                      | Type   | Units   | Limits                                             | Description                                                        |
|--------------------------------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `h_1__meter`                         | double | meters  | $1 \leq h_1 \leq 3000$                             | Low antenna height above MSL                                       |
| `antenna_1_pattern`                  | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-antenna_pattern                      | Type of antenna at lower terminal                                  |
| `antenna_1_use`                      | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-antenna_use                          | Whether the low antenna is directive or tracking                   |
| `antenna_1_polarization`             | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-antenna_polarization                 | Polarization of low antenna                                        |
| `antenna_1_tilt__deg`                | double | degrees | $-90 \leq antenna_1\_tilt \leq 90$                 | Tilt of the low antenna                                            |
| `antenna_1_half_half_beamwidth__deg` | double | degrees | $1 \leq antenna_1\_half\_half\_beamwidth \leq 45$  | Half of the half power beamwidth of low antenna                    |
| `h_fss__meter`                       | double | meters  | $0 \leq h\_fss \leq 4000$                          | Elevation of the facility site surface above mean sea level        |
| `rainfall_zone`                      | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-rainfall_zone                        | Rainfall zone through which the transmission takes place           |
| `storm_size`                         | int    | km      | $storm\_size \geq 0$ (See @tbl-if77-storm_size)    | Size of the rainstorm between antennas                             |
| `terrain_type`                       | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-terrain_type                         | Type of terrain                                                    |
| `horizon_input`                      | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-horizon_input                        | How the horizon obstacle will be specified                         |
| `delta_h__meter`                     | double | meters  | $0 \leq delta_h \leq 700$                          | Interdecile range of the terrain profile                           |
| `d_hzn__km`                          | double | km      | $d\_hzn \geq 0$                                    | Distance to low antenna's horizon                                  |
| `h_hzn__meter`                       | double | meters  | $0 \leq h\_hzn \leq 1500$                          | Height of low antenna's horizon                                    |
| `low_horizon_angle_degrees`          | int    | degrees | $-12 \leq low\_horizon\_angle\_degrees \leq 12$    | Degree portion of the low horizon angle                            |
| `low_horizon_angle_minutes`          | int    | minutes | $-60 \leq low\_horizon\_angle\_minutes \leq 60$    | Minutes portion of the low horizon angle                           |
| `low_horizon_angle_seconds`          | int    | seconds | $-60 \leq low\_horizon\_angle\_seconds \leq 60$    | Seconds portion of the low horizon angle                           |
| `counterpoise_diameter__meter`       | double | meters  | $counterpoise\_diameter \geq 0$                    | Diameter of the low antenna's reflecting counterpoise              |
| `counterpoise_height__meter`         | double | meters  | $counterpoise\_height \geq 0$                      | Height of the low antenna's reflecting counterpoise                |
| `counterpoise_material`              | enum   |         | See @tbl-if77-material                             | Reflective properties of the low antenna's reflecting counterpoise |
: Card2 structure for the if77 propagation model {#tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card2}

The `antenna_1_pattern` input must be one of the following desired antenna patterns in **AntennaPattern enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-antenna_pattern.

| Enum Value | Antenna Pattern enum                           |
|------------|------------------------------------------------|
| 1          | Isotropic antenna                              |
| 2          | DME antenna                                    |
| 3          | TACAN (RTA-2) antenna                          |
| 4          | 4-loop array (cosine vertical pattern) antenna |
| 5          | 8-loop array (cosine vertical pattern) antenna |
| 6          | I or II (cosine vertical pattern) antenna      |
| 7          | JTAC with tilted antenna                       |
: Allowed antenna pattern values {#tbl-if77-antenna_pattern}

The `antenna_1_use` input must be one of the following desired antenna use values in **AntennaUse enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-antenna_use.

| Enum Value | Antenna Use enum  |
|------------|-------------------|
| 0          | Directive antenna |
| 1          | Tracking antenna  |
: Allowed antenna use values {#tbl-if77-antenna_use}

The `antenna_1_polarization` input must be one of the following desired antenna polarizations in **AntennaPolarization enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-antenna_polarization.

| Enum Value | Antenna Polarization enum       |
|------------|---------------------------------|
| 1          | Horizontal antenna polarization |
| 2          | Vertical antenna polarization   |
| 3          | Circular antenna polarization   |
: Allowed antenna polarization values {#tbl-if77-antenna_polarization}

The `rainfall_zone` input must be one of the following desired rainfall zones in **RainfallZone enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-rainfall_zone.

| Enum Value | Rainfall Zone enum                                |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| 0          | No rainfall is considered                         |
| 1          | Rainfall zone 1                                   |
| 2          | Rainfall zone 2                                   |
| 3          | Rainfall zone 3                                   |
| 4          | Rainfall zone 4                                   |
| 5          | Rainfall zone 5                                   |
| 6          | Rainfall zone 6                                   |
| 7          | 0.5 dB times the value in path_storm_size is used |
: Allowed rainfall zone values {#tbl-if77-rainfall_zone}

The `storm_size` input must be one of the following values if rainfall zone is `0.5 dB times the value in path_storm_size is used`, as defined in @tbl-if77-storm_size.

| Value | Storm Size in km         |
|------------|---------------------|
| 0          | No storm            |
| 5          | Storm size of 5 km  |
| 10         | Storm size of 10 km |
| 20         | Storm size of 20 km |
: Allowed storm size values if rainfall zone is 7 {#tbl-if77-storm_size}

The `terrain_type` input must be one of the following desired terrain types in **TerrainType enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-terrain_type.

| Enum Value | Terrain Type enum    |
|------------|----------------------|
| 1          | Smooth earth terrain |
| 2          | Irregular terrain    |
: Allowed terrain type values {#tbl-if77-terrain_type}

The `horizon_input` input must be one of the following desired horizon inputs in **HorizonInput enum**, as defined in @tbl-if77-horizon_input.

| Enum Value | Horizon Input enum                                                    |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0          | No horizon obstacle is specified                                      |
| 1          | Horizon obstacle specified by elevation angle                         |
| 2          | Horizon obstacle specified by its height                              |
| 3          | Horizon obstacle specified by both its elevation angle and its height |
: Allowed horizon input values {#tbl-if77-horizon_input}

| Enum Value | Material enum                           |

| 0          | No counterpoise                         |

| 2          | Counterpoise material is good ground    |
| 3          | Counterpoise material is average ground |
| 4          | Counterpoise material is poor ground    |
| 5          | Counterpoise material is fresh water    |
| 6          | Counterpoise material is concrete       |
| 7          | Counterpoise material is metallic       |

| `weight_1`                           | int    |         | $weight_1 \geq 0$                                 | Low antenna weighting value for climate mixing                |

| 13         | November - April, hours 1800 - 2400 |

**if77 Outputs**

The IF77 model produces an output with a return code (see [here](errors.qmd#return-codes)) and a Result structure which contains five values provided in @tbl-if77-outputs-result.

| Result structure         | Type   | Units   | Description                                         |
|--------------------------|--------|---------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `warning`                | int    |         | Warning flags, see [here](errors.qmd#warning-flags) |
| `takeoff_angle__degrees` | double | degrees | Takeoff angle                                       |
| `propagation_mode`       | enum   |         | Mode of propagation, see @tbl-if77-propagation_mode |
| `A_fs__db`               | double | db      | Free space loss                                     |
| `A__db`                  | double | db      | Total loss                                          |
: Result structure for the if77 propagation model {#tbl-if77-outputs-result}

The output of `propagation_mode` is one of the values in `PropagationMode` enum, as defined in @tbl-if77-propagation_mode.

| Enum Value | Propagation Mode enum             |
|------------|-----------------------------------|
| 0          | Mode of propagation not set       |
| 1          | Line of sight mode of propagation |
| 2          | Diffraction mode of propagation   |
| 3          | Troposcatter mode of propagation  |
: Propagation mode values {#tbl-if77-propagation_mode}

### IF77 Extended Model

This function implements the primary method of the IF-77 electromagnetic wave propagation model with Internal results. The inputs for this function are the same as if77 model which are 3 Card structures shown above in @tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card1, @tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card2, @tbl-if77-inputs-if77-card3.

**Internal Outputs**

In additional to the return code (see [here](errors.qmd#return-codes)) and Result structure provided in @tbl-if77-outputs-result, this extended model provides 3 internal outputs contain low/high terminals and path information in Terminal structure shown in @tbl-if77-outputs-terminal and Path structure shown in @tbl-if77-outputs-path.

| Terminal structure | Type   | Units   | Description                                             |
|--------------------|--------|---------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| `h__km`            | double | km      | Actual height used in model                             |
| `h_r__km`          | double | km      | Real height above MSL                                   |
| `h_e__km`          | double | km      | Effective height above reflecting surface               |
| `h_rs__km`         | double | km      | Real height above reflecting surface                    |
| `delta_h__km`      | double | km      | Delta between real height and effective height          |
| `d__km`            | double | km      | Actual horizon distance used                            |
| `d_r__km`          | double | km      | Ray traced smooth earth horizon distance                |
| `d_hzn__km`        | double | km      | Distance to the terminals horizon used in calcs         |
| `theta_r__rad`     | double | degrees | Terminal geometry angle, in rad                         |
| `theta_ray__rad`   | double | degrees | Incident angle of the ray, in rad                       |
| `theta_hzn__rad`   | double | degrees | Angle to the horizon (smooth earth or obstacle), in rad |
| `theta_TO__rad`    | double | degrees | Takeoff angle of ray, in rad                            |
| `z_e__km`          | double | km      | Radial from Earth center to top of antenna              |
: Terminal structure for the if77 propagation model {#tbl-if77-outputs-terminal}

| Path structure          | Type   | Units   | Description                                                                  |
|-------------------------|--------|---------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `h_sur__km`             | double | km      | Height of the reflecting surface                                             |
| `h_fss__km`             | double | km      | Height of the facility site surface above MSL                                |
| `h_1fss__km`            | double | km      | Height of the low antenna above the facility site surface                    |
| `h_hzn__km`             | double | km      | Height of the horizon from the low terminal                                  |
| `d_ML__km`              | double | km      | Maximum line-of-sight distance                                               |
| `d__km`                 | double | km      | Great-circle path distance                                                   |
| `d_0__km`               | double | km      | Largest distance in LOS region where diffraction effects are negligible      |
| `d_d__km`               | double | km      | Initial estimate of d_0                                                      |
| `psi_limit__rad`        | double | degrees | Largest angle at which lobing effects are considered, in rad                 |
| `delta_h__km`           | double | km      | Terrain irregularity parameter                                               |
| `N_0`                   | double | N-Units | Refractivity                                                                 |
| `N_s`                   | double | N-Units | Surface refractivity                                                         |
| `material_enum`         | enum   |         | Ground material, see @tbl-if77-material                                      |
| `sigma`                 | double | S/m     | Conductivity                                                                 |
| `epsilon`               | double |         | Relative permittivity                                                        |
| `a_e__km`               | double | km      | Effective Earth radius                                                       |
| `water_temp__celsius`   | double | celsius | Water temperature                                                            |
| `use_user_sigma_h_flag` | enum   |         | Use user defined conductivity flag, see @tbl-if77-water_wave_height_use_flag |
| `user_sigma_h`          | double | S/m     | User defined conductivity                                                    |
| `water_state`           | enum   |         | Water state enum for average wave height range, see @tbl-if77-water_state    |
| `lobing`                | bool   |         | Whether lobing is used                                                       |
| `psi__rad`              | double | degrees | Reflection angle, in rad                                                     |
| `terrain_type`          | enum   |         | Terrain type enum, see @tbl-if77-terrain_type                                |
: Path structure for the if77 propagation model {#tbl-if77-outputs-path}

## Error Codes and Warning Flags ##

IF77 supports a defined list of error codes and warning flags. A complete list can be found [here](errors.qmd).

## Intermedia Functions

### Time variability function

This model implements . The inputs for this model are shown below in @tbl-p676-inputs-slant-path-attenuation.

| Variable      | Type   | Units | Limits                   | Description                     |
|---------------|--------|-------|--------------------------|---------------------------------|
| `f__ghz`      | double | GHz   | $0 \leq f \leq 1000$     | Frequency                       |
| `h_1__km`     | double | km    | $h_1 \geq 0$             | Height of the low terminal      |
| `h_2__km`     | double | km    | $h_2 \geq 0$             | Height of the high terminal     |
| `beta_1__rad` | double | rad   | $beta_1 \geq 0$          | Elevation angle (from zenith)   |
| `atmosphere`  | enum   | N/A   | See @tbl-p676-atmosphere | Reference atmosphere from P.835 |
: Inputs for the slant path gaseous attenuation model {#tbl-p676-inputs-slant-path-attenuation}

The slant path gaseous attenuation model produces an output which contains five values which are provided in @tbl-p676-outputs.

| Variable        | Type    | Units | Description                    |
|-----------------|---------|-------|--------------------------------|
| `A_gas__db`     | double  | dB    | Gaseous attenuation            |
| `bending__rad`  | double  | rad   | Bending angle                  |
| `a__km`         | double  | km    | Ray length                     |
| `incident__rad` | double  | rad   | Incident angle at h_2          |
| `delta_L__km`   | double  | km    | Excess atmospheric path length |
: Outputs of the slant path gaseous attenuation model {#tbl-p676-outputs}
